description.value: The Improv Centre is Vancouver's home for live comedy, located on Granville Island and internationally recognized for its flagship Theatresports™ shows — a high-energy, audience-judged improv competition the company has been performing for over 40 years. It operates as a registered charitable organization offering unscripted performances, improv classes, and community workshops in a waterfront theatre setting. Granville Island is a natural cycling destination, and the venue explicitly lists bicycle as one of the recommended ways to arrive.

The contact page has a 'Parking & Bicycles' section and lists bicycle as an explicit transport mode to the venue, but the bicycle-specific parking content was truncated before confirming rack details. A significant phone number discrepancy exists: OSM lists +1-604-280-4444 while the website consistently shows 604-738-7013 across multiple pages.
